# netdata_node (Data Source)

The Netdata Node Data Source allows you to retrieve information about a specific node in a Netdata Cloud space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netdata_node" "test" {
  space_id = "<space_id>"
  room_id  = "<room_id>"
  name     = "<node_name>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the node
- `space_id` (String) The ID of the space, where the node is placed

### Optional

- `room_id` (String) The ID of the room, where the node is placed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the node
